title: German Apple Crumble
description: A classic German dessert featuring tender apples topped with a crunchy crumble made from almonds and a hint of nutty flavor.

ingredients.name: Crumble
ingredients.amount: 1 cup all-purpose flour, 1/2 cup granulated sugar, 1/2 cup cold unsalted butter, crumbled

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine sliced apples, cinnamon, and vanilla extract. Mix well.
Transfer the apple mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together flour, sugar, and cold butter until crumbly.
Add sliced almonds to the crumble mixture and mix until well combined.
Spread the crumble mixture evenly over the apple mixture.
Bake for 40-45 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.
